title: Mixed Event — Happy Lovely Everyday! — Episode7 Happy Everyday!

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! are delighted to receive a request to perform at an elementary school. With experience performing in children's variety shows under her belt, Airi enthusiastically starts planning for the event.

rows.Line: se_event_everyday_2021_003
The day of the graduation event
Gym

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, they must be first-graders! They're so cute! I can't believe how little they are...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Careful, Minori. If you stick your head out too far, they'll see you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Just move back slowly...
se_event_everyday_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hey, I'm back.
The teachers said that they'll help us film our stream. We should be all set now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's great!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for doing that, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, are we all ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We'll start by playing some games with the students. Then they'll get to see our show, and Airi will finish with her solo performance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We should be good to go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, let's do this!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's make today one that they won't forget!!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
se_event_everyday_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We have some special guests here with us today! Well, you probably already know who since you sent them some messages.
se_event_everyday_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Yeah!!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Then let's give a big round of applause for MORE MORE JUMP!
se_event_everyday_2021_007

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Whoa! It's really them!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
It's Happy Everyday!
This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: T-shirt Boy
rows.Line: What's so great about Happy Everyday? Everything she did on TV was so stupid.

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: N-No, you're wrong...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
We're MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting us here today! We know how much this day means to all of you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're hoping that you get to have lots of fun with us today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So let's get started with some... Super fun games!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll start with a team-based tag competition! Our first matchup will be Team Minori versus Team Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Only one person is allowed to be it, but you can always ask someone else on your team to tag in for you if you're having trouble catching people.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You'll also receive points based on who you catch and which grade they're in. For example, one point for first-graders and six points for sixth-graders.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And if you catch a leader, like me or Haruka, you'll get ten points!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is a chance for the good runners out there to really shine, but we won't let you catch us that easily, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's all do our best, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll start us off!
Ready... Go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
E-Everybody's so fast!
What do I do?!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Got you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! You got me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ten points for Team Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's keep this up, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's see the results for Team Minori versus Team Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: 33 to 65! Team Haruka wins!

rows.Speaker: Team Haruka Students
rows.Line:
Yay!
Haruka, we did it!
se_event_everyday_2021_006

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. All of you did a wonderful job. Great work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nooo... I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
You did your best!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Cheer up, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's so nice of you...!
Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, next is Team Airi versus Team Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's do our best, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're not about to let you walk away with this! We'll win if we put our heads together, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Yeah!!
se_event_everyday_2021_004

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me again?! Why's everybody coming after me?!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Got you, Happy Everyday!

rows.Speaker: Girl Spectating
rows.Line: No fair! I wanna play tag with Airi too!

rows.Speaker: Boy Spectating
rows.Line: The sports competition they did on Wide World of Laughs was so good too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow...!
They really love Airi, don't they?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, they do.
I knew that kids really like her, but I wasn't expecting this kind of response.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*...!
Geez, they're all coming after me now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (These kids really are from the generation that saw me on TV back then...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They really genuinely like what I did...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh heh heh! That won't be enough to catch me...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Watch as I do some... Happy Side Steps!!
se_event_everyday_2021_005

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh wow! She's really doing Happy Side Steps!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Happy Side Steps...?
What are those? Can you explain...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's one of Happy Everyday's strongest skills! She taunts enemy idols into attacking her by showing off her super idol stamina!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She taunts enemy idols...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I never thought that I'd get to see her do this again...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Faster! Faster!
Wanna try catching me now?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Uh oh...!
My leg... Cramp!
se_event_everyday_2021_005

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Got you, Happy Everyday!
Yay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oww... I got way ahead of myself there...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi! Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Maybe. I'm not sure...
Could you help me back up, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Gotcha!
Ten points to Team Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
A-Airi... You tricked me!
But we can still win!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, guys, it's our turn to run!
Follow Happy Everyday!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Okay!
se_event_everyday_2021_004

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now, for our final question! Dun-duh!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
True or false...?
The principal's name is Yoko Nakano.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This is true, right...?
That means...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
True!
Great job, you guys! Congrats!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Yay!!
se_event_everyday_2021_006

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That concludes our games portion of today's event.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no... I'm exhausted from running around so much... But I still need to do my best during our show...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
How are you doing, Airi?
You have to do a show on top of ours so...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm fine! Don't worry!
Remember, I have more stamina than most people!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially since I'm singing that song. I need to put everything behind it!
song00004_off_f

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, let's try it together now!
One, two...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MORE MORE... JUMP!!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: JUMP!!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: This is so much fun!
se_event_everyday_2021_006

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I jumped really high just now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Everyone!
Unfortunately, our show is almost over!
Are you ready for our final song?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Aww, really? It's almost over?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sad that it has to end so soon too. But we'll be finishing with a performance by today's star and fan favorite, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Happy Everyday gets her own show?

rows.Speaker: T-shirt Boy
rows.Line: Happy Everyday's gonna sing? Wait, doesn't that mean she's gonna sing a bunch of really weird songs?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She'll be ready momentarily, so we ask that you please be patient!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi, ready...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. Ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna wrap up past me and present me into a single package, and show them what Airi Momoi is really about!
